snippet.title: You played my steam demo | Metro Gravity Devlog 3
snippet.description:
Wishlist Metro Gravity!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2986450/Metro_Gravity/ 

Join the discord!
https://discord.gg/RM5hktBqrv 

Other socials: https://linktr.ee/mrkogamedev

In this devlog, I ramble about gathering the feedback from the Steam demo, grappling with scope and priorities, and the stuff I've been adding to the game.

0:00 - Intro
0:31 - The feedback form
1:04 - One small issue
1:35 - Puzzle Design
2:14 - Case Study: Triple Galileo Flamethrower
3:21 - The balance
4:05 - Realization
5:12 - On a good note
5:44 - Gizmos and doodads
6:36 - Games I should've been inspired by
7:06 - The importance of planning
